title: Pure Symphonic Warrior
summary: Symphonic Warrior cards only, with generic Synchros, Links and staples. Symphonic Warriors are WIND Machine Pendulums and Tuners that change their own Levels, Types and Attributes. Symph Amplifire gains a counter every time a Symphonic Warrior effect resolves, then spends 5 counters to burn or 7 to banish their cards. Symphonic Warrior Guitaar summons a Symphonic Warrior from the Deck as a Scale and revives one on Normal Summon. Symphonic Warrior Synthess searches one when flipped. The 2022 cards lead. Symphonic Warrior DJJ flips your Synthess face-up and summons itself from the Scale whenever a Symphonic Warrior effect activates. Symphonic Warrior Guitariss is a Tuner that summons itself under Amplifire. Symphonic Warrior Rockks returns Pendulums from the Extra Deck to the hand every Standby Phase.
